verdict.rationale: Netlify documents first-party, low-boilerplate access to storage via `getStore("file-uploads")` with no credential wiring, managed Postgres through Netlify Database, and "instant databases and file storage." AI Gateway connects to models without managing API keys, and team-scoped secrets/env vars plus directory integrations (Turso, Supabase) cover third-party services. missing for 10: detailed docs showing how databases bind to code without connection strings or credentials, evidence that arbitrary third-party APIs get native bindings rather than env-var/SDK wiring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
